blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: At your service, madam!
exercises.why: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion. After a verb of motion, к followed by a noun denoting a person indicates going to see that person at his place: *Я иду к полковнику.* Followed by a noun denoting an object or a place, it indicates motion toward that object or place: *Студент идёт к доске. Самолёты летят к морю. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 29. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.
exercises.context: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 29. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0))
